phrases.english: What time is it, please?
I’m running late, sorry.
It’s a quarter past eight.
It’s almost ten o’clock.
We’ll meet at seven sharp.
Where is the checkout counter, please?
How much is this, exactly?
Can I try this on, please?
I only want one piece.
Do you have it in small size?
It’s sunny today, enjoy the day.
phrases.odia: ଆଜି ସୂର୍ଯ୍ୟକିରଣ ଅଛି, ଦିନଟା ଉପଭୋଗ କରନ୍ତୁ।
phrases.transliteration: Aji surjya-kiran achhi, dinata upabhoga karantu.

phrases.english: Clouds are gathering, it might rain.
The rain is light, don’t worry.
It’s raining now, take an umbrella.
The wind is strong today, be careful.
phrases.odia: ଆଜି ପବନ ବେଶ ଜୋର, ସାବଧାନ ରୁହନ୍ତୁ।
phrases.transliteration: Aji paban besh jor, sabadhaana ruhantu.

phrases.english: I practice daily, slowly, and keep going.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ପ୍ରତିଦିନ ଅଭ୍ୟାସ କରେ, ଧୀରେ ଧୀରେ, ଆଉ ଚାଲୁ ରଖେ।
phrases.transliteration: Muṁ pratidina abhyaasa kare, dhire dhire, aau chalu rakhe.

phrases.english: Today, I will try again, no worries.
phrases.odia: ଆଜି, ମୁଁ ପୁନି ଚେଷ୍ଟା କରିବି, ଚିନ୍ତା ନାହିଁ।
phrases.transliteration: Aji, muṁ puni chesta karibi, chinta nahin.

phrases.english: I’m improving, one small step at a time.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ଉନ୍ନତି କରୁଛି, ପ୍ରତିଥର ଗୋଟିଏ ଛୋଟ ପଦକ୍ଷେପରେ।
phrases.transliteration: Muṁ unnati karuchhi, pratyekathara gotie chhota padakhepare.

phrases.english: Keep breathing, and speak with confidence.
Mistakes help me learn, so relax.
phrases.odia: ଭୁଲମାନେ ମୋତେ ଶିଖାଏ, ତେଣୁ ଆରାମ କର।
phrases.transliteration: Bhulumane mote shikha‘e, tena au aaram kar.

phrases.english: A cow is eating grass, slowly.
The cat wants to come inside, please.
Look at the dog, it’s wagging.
That bird is singing outside, loudly.
The frog is jumping near the pond.
I love this song, it’s so catchy.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ଏହି ଗୀତଟାକୁ ଭଲପାଏ, ବହୁତ ଆକର୍ଷକ।
phrases.transliteration: Mu ehi geetataaku bhala paaye, bahuta aakarshaka.

phrases.english: Play it again, please.
That rhythm feels amazing.
Turn the volume up a little.
Turn it down, it’s too loud.
I need a smaller EMI this month.
phrases.odia: ମୋ ଏହି ମାସରେ ଛୋଟ EMI ଦରକାର।
phrases.transliteration: Mo ei masare chhota EMI darkar.

phrases.english: Please check my bank balance now.
phrases.odia: ଦୟାକରି ବର୍ତ୍ତମାନ ମୋ ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ ବ୍ୟାଲାନ୍ସ ଯାଞ୍ଚ କର।
phrases.transliteration: Dayakari bartaman mo bank balance janch kar.

phrases.english: Did my salary get credited today, please?
phrases.odia: ଆଜି ମୋ ଦରମା ଆସିଛି କି, ଦୟାକରି?
phrases.transliteration: Aji mo dhrama asichi ki, dayakari?

phrases.english: I want to open a savings account.
The ATM declined my card again.
phrases.odia: ଏହି ATM ଆଉଥରେ ମୋ କାର୍ଡ ଅସ୍ଵୀକାର କରିଲା।
phrases.transliteration: Ei ATM autehare mo card aswikar karila.

phrases.english: I love you, my heart.
You make me feel safe, always.
I miss you, please come back.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ତୁମକୁ ମିସ୍ କରୁଛି, ଦୟାକରି ଫେରିଆସ।
phrases.transliteration: Muṁ tumaku mis karuchi, dayakari feriās.

phrases.english: Stay with me, just tonight.
Your smile is my favorite thing.
Thank you for your kindness, really.
I truly appreciate your help today.
phrases.odia: ଆଜି ଆପଣଙ୍କ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ ପାଇଁ ମୁଁ ଖୁବ ଆଭାରୀ।
phrases.transliteration: Aji apananka sahajya paain mu sebu aabari.

phrases.english: Thanks, you made my day better.
phrases.odia: ଧନ୍ୟବାଦ, ଆପଣ ମୋ ଦିନଟା ଭଲ କରିଦେଲେ।
phrases.transliteration: Dhanyabad, apana mo dinata bhala karidele.

phrases.english: I’m grateful for everything you do.
phrases.odia: ଆପଣ କରୁଥିବା ସବୁକିଛି ପାଇଁ ମୁଁ ଆଭାରୀ।
phrases.transliteration: Apana karuthiba sabukichhi paain mu aabari.

phrases.english: Thank you for listening to me.
I will improve, day by day,
Stay calm, even when things change,
I can learn from every mistake,
Small steps, big progress, you know,
Today, I choose to do my best,
I can face this, step by step.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ଏହାକୁ ସାମ୍ନା କରିପାରିବି, ପଦେ ପଦେ।
phrases.transliteration: Mu eha ku saamna karipaaribi, pade pade.

phrases.english: Take a deep breath, you’ve got this.
Don’t be afraid, speak up now.
I’ll try again, even if it’s hard.
phrases.odia: କଠିନ ହେଲେମଧ୍ୟ, ମୁଁ ପୁଣି ଚେଷ୍ଟା କରିବି।
phrases.transliteration: Kathiina helamadhya, mu puni chesta karibi.

phrases.english: Be brave, small steps still count.
phrases.odia: ସାହସ କର, ଛୋଟ ପଦକ୍ଷେପ ମଧ୍ୟ ଗଣିଯାଏ।
phrases.transliteration: Sahasa kara, chhota padakhepa madhya gani jaae.

phrases.english: I breathe in, and I feel calm.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ଶ୍ୱାସ ନେଉଛି, ଆଉ ମୁଁ ଶାନ୍ତ ଲାଗୁଛି।
phrases.transliteration: Mũ shwasa neuchi, aau mũ shaanta laguchhi.

phrases.english: In silence, my heart settles down.
Let go now, everything is okay.
phrases.odia: ଏବେ ଛାଡ଼ି ଦେଅ, ସବୁ ଠିକ ଅଛି।
phrases.transliteration: Ebe chhadi deau, sabu thik achhi.

phrases.english: I choose peace, not worry.
My mind feels lighter, one moment.
phrases.odia: ମୋ ମନ ହାଲୁକା ଲାଗୁଛି, ଏକ ମୁହୂର୍ତ୍ତ।
phrases.transliteration: Mo mana haluka laguchhi, eka muhurtta.

phrases.english: I study Odia every morning, slowly.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ପ୍ରତିଦିନ ସକାଳେ ଓଡ଼ିଆ ପଢ଼ୁଛି, ଧୀରେ।
phrases.transliteration: Mū pratidina sakālE oḍia paḍhuchi, dheire.

phrases.english: Can you explain this lesson, please?
phrases.transliteration: Dayakari ehi pāṭaṭi bujhāi pāribe ki?

phrases.english: I don’t understand this word, yet.
phrases.transliteration: Ehi shabdaṭa mū ejābat bujhi pāruni.

phrases.english: Please speak a little more slowly.
What does this sentence mean, in Odia?
What festivals are you celebrating this month?
Today, we all meet at the temple.
People here share food with neighbors.
phrases.odia: ଏଠାର ଲୋକମାନେ ପଡ଼ୋଶୀଙ୍କ ସହ ଖାଦ୍ୟ ବାଣ୍ଟନ୍ତି।
phrases.transliteration: Ethaara lokamanen padośiṅka saha khaadya baṇṭanti.

phrases.english: Do you drink tea after morning prayers?
phrases.odia: ସକାଳ ପୂଜା ପରେ ଆପଣ ଚାହା ପିଅନ୍ତି କି?
phrases.transliteration: Sakaal pooja pare apana chaaha pibhanti ki?

phrases.english: We greet elders with folded hands.
phrases.odia: ଆମେ ବୟସ୍କମାନଙ୍କୁ ହାତ ଯୋଡ଼ି ଶୁଭେଚ୍ଛା ଦେଉ।
phrases.transliteration: Ame bayaskamananku haata joḍi shubhechchha deu.

phrases.english: Hello, how are you today?
Hi there, good to see you!
Good morning, have a nice day!
phrases.odia: ଶୁଭ ସକାଳ, ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଦିନ ଭଲ ହେଉ!
phrases.transliteration: Shubha sakala, apankara dina bhala heau!

phrases.english: Good afternoon, hope you’re doing well.
phrases.odia: ଶୁଭ ଦୁପୁର, ଆପଣ ଭଲ ଥାନ୍ତୁ ବୋଲି ଆଶା କରୁଛି।
phrases.transliteration: Shubha dupura, apan bhala thantu boli asha karuchhi.

phrases.english: Good evening, how’s your day going?
phrases.odia: ଶୁଭ ସନ୍ଧ୍ୟା, ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଦିନ କେମିତି ଚାଲୁଛି?
phrases.transliteration: Shubha sandhya, apankara dina kemiti chaluchhi?

phrases.english: I can do this, step by step.
Stay strong, you’re not alone here.
phrases.odia: ଦୃଢ଼ ରୁହ, ତୁମେ ଏଠାରେ ଏକା ନୁହଁ।
phrases.transliteration: Drudha rōha, tume ehāre eka nuha.

phrases.english: Breathe, then try again.
phrases.odia: ଶ୍ୱାସ ନିଅ, ତାପରେ ଆଉଥରେ ଚେଷ୍ଟା କର।
phrases.transliteration: Shwāsa nīa, tāpare āuthare chesta kara.

phrases.english: I’ve got this, don’t worry.
Keep going, even when it’s hard.
My purpose is to help others, always.
phrases.odia: ମୋ ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ ସଦା ଅନ୍ୟମାନଙ୍କୁ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରିବା।
phrases.transliteration: Mo uddeshya sada anyamananku sahajya kariba.

phrases.english: I want to learn Odia, every day.
My purpose today is simple, just work.
phrases.odia: ଆଜି ମୋ ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ ସରଳ, କେବଳ କାମ।
phrases.transliteration: Aji mo uddeshya sarala, kebala kaam.

phrases.english: I’m here to try, not to quit.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ଛାଡ଼ିଦେବା ପାଇଁ ନୁହେଁ, ଚେଷ୍ଟା କରିବାକୁ ଆସିଛି।
phrases.transliteration: Mu chhadideba pain nuhen, chesta karibaku asichhi.

phrases.english: My purpose is peace, and kindness.
Inhale slowly, feel the room around you.
phrases.odia: ଧୀରେ ଶ୍ୱାସ ନିଅ, ତୁମ ଚାରିପଟେ ଅନୁଭବ କର।
phrases.transliteration: Dhire shwas ni’o, tuma charipate anubhaba kara.

phrases.english: Exhale gently, relax your shoulders now.
phrases.odia: ଧୀରେ ଶ୍ୱାସ ଛାଡ଼, ଏବେ ତୁମ ଦେହ ଶିଥିଲା କର।
phrases.transliteration: Dhire shwas chhād’o, ebe tuma deha shitilā kara.

phrases.english: Feel your feet, grounded and steady.
phrases.odia: ତୁମ ପାଦକୁ ଅନୁଭବ କର, ଭଲ ଭାବରେ ଦୃଢ଼।
phrases.transliteration: Tuma padaku anubhaba kara, bhala bhabare dr̥iḍha.

phrases.english: Let your breath be your guide.
phrases.odia: ତୁମ ଶ୍ୱାସକୁ ନିଜର ପଥପ୍ରଦର୍ଶକ ହେବାକୁ ଦିଅ।
phrases.transliteration: Tuma shwasaku nijara pathapradarshaka hebāku di’o.

phrases.english: Right now, be present with me.
phrases.odia: ଏଇ ମୁହୂର୍ତ୍ତରେ, ମୋ ସହିତ ଉପସ୍ଥିତ ରୁହ।
phrases.transliteration: Ei muhurtta re, mo sahita upasthita ruh.

phrases.english: I drink warm water every morning, slowly.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ପ୍ରତି ସକାଳେ ଧୀରେ ଧୀରେ ଗୁନା ପାଣି ପିଉଛି।
phrases.transliteration: Mu prti sakale dhire dhire guna pani pijuchi.

phrases.english: Please wash your hands before eating, now.
phrases.odia: ଦୟାକରି ଖାଇବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ହାତ ଧୁଅ, ଏବେ।
phrases.transliteration: Dayakari khaiaba purbaru hata dhu, ebe.

phrases.english: Do you have any headache today?
phrases.odia: ଆଜି ତୁମର କିଛି ମୁଣ୍ଡବିଥା ଅଛି କି?
phrases.transliteration: Aji tumara kichhi mundabitha achhi ki?

phrases.english: I feel better after rest, thank you.
phrases.odia: ବିଶ୍ରାମ ପରେ ମୋତେ ଭଲ ଲାଗୁଛି, ଧନ୍ୟବାଦ।
phrases.transliteration: Bishram pare mote bhal laguchhi, dhanyabad.

phrases.english: Let’s walk outside for ten minutes.
My wife makes our home happy, always.
phrases.odia: ମୋ ସ୍ତ୍ରୀ ଆମ ଘରକୁ ସଦା ଖୁସି କରେ।
phrases.transliteration: mo stri amara gharaku sada khusi kare

phrases.english: I miss my brother, we should talk.
phrases.odia: ମୋ ଭାଇକୁ ମୁଁ ଭଲେ ପାଏ, କଥା ହେବା ଦରକାର।
phrases.transliteration: mo bhai ku mu bhale pae, katha heba darkar

phrases.english: My friend always listens, thank you.
Your father is kind, I can tell.
I love my sister, she understands me.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ମୋ ଭଉଣୀକୁ ଭଲ ପାଏ, ସେ ମୋତେ ବୁଝେ।
phrases.transliteration: mu mo bhouṇiki ku bhala pae, se mote bujhe

phrases.english: I feel happy today, really happy.
phrases.odia: ଆଜି ମୋ ମନ ଖୁସି, ବହୁତ ଖୁସି।
phrases.transliteration: Aji mo mana khusi, bahuta khusi.

phrases.english: A warm smile makes me happy.
I’m grateful, and I feel light.
My heart is calm right now.
Good news always makes me smile.
I want some rice, please.
phrases.transliteration: daya kari, mote kichi bhata diontu

phrases.english: This curry is really tasty.
Can I have a glass of water?
phrases.odia: ମୋତେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଗ୍ଲାସ୍‌ ପାଣି ମିଳିବ କି?
phrases.transliteration: mote gotie ghlas pani miliba ki

phrases.english: I’m hungry, give me something.
Please make it less spicy.
phrases.transliteration: daya kari, eha ku kam tikt karantu

phrases.english: I need balance today, please.
Take a deep breath, stay calm.
I’m trying to feel steady.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ନିଜକୁ ଧୀରେ ଧୀରେ ଠିକ୍ ରଖିବାକୁ ଚେଷ୍ଟା କରୁଛି।
phrases.transliteration: Mu mu nijaku dhire dhire thik rakhikaku chesta karuchhi.

phrases.english: Let’s walk slowly, no rush.
Keep your weight centered, please.
phrases.transliteration: Dayakari tumara ojan madhyabaghara re rakh.

phrases.english: My head hurts, today.
Touch your forehead gently.
I hurt my tooth badly.
phrases.transliteration: mo daant khub jantrana heu chhi.

phrases.english: Keep your teeth clean, please.
My back is sore right now.
phrases.transliteration: ebe mo pithi jantrana heu chhi.

phrases.english: I’ll try something new today.
phrases.odia: ଆଜି ମୁଁ କିଛି ନୂଆ ଚେଷ୍ଟା କରିବି।
phrases.transliteration: Aji mu kichi nua chesta karibi.

phrases.english: My ideas come from everyday moments.
phrases.transliteration: Mo dharana dainika muhurta ru ase.

phrases.english: Let’s make it creative and fun.
phrases.odia: ଚଳ, ଏହାକୁ ସୃଜନଶୀଳ ଓ ମଜାଦାର କରିବା।
phrases.transliteration: Chala, eha ku srujanashila o majadar kariba.

phrases.english: I’m mixing colors for a new look.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ନୂଆ ଲୁକ ପାଇଁ ରଙ୍ଗ ମିଶାଉଛି।

phrases.english: That’s a clever idea, really!
I start work at eight today, yes.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ଆଜି ଆଠଟାରେ କାମ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରୁଛି, ହଁ।
phrases.transliteration: Mũ aaji aathatare kaam aarambha karuchi, hã.

phrases.english: Can you help me with this task?
phrases.odia: ତୁମେ ଏହି କାମରେ ମୋତେ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରିବ କି?
phrases.transliteration: Tume ei kaamare mote sahaajya kariba ki?

phrases.english: Please send the file to me now.
phrases.transliteration: Daya kari ebe phaaill-ti mote pathao.

phrases.english: I will finish this by evening, don’t worry.
phrases.odia: ସନ୍ଧ୍ୟା ସୁଦ୍ଧା ମୁଁ ଏହା ସରିକରିଦେବି, ଚିନ୍ତା କରନି।
phrases.transliteration: Sandhya suddhha mũ eiha sarikaridebi, chinta karani.

phrases.english: That meeting is at three o’clock today.
Where is my shirt, please?
This T-shirt feels too tight.
My jeans are torn at the knee.
Can I try this dress on?
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ଏହି ଡ୍ରେସ୍ ପରିବାକୁ ପାରିବି କି?
phrases.transliteration: muṁ ei dress paribāku pāribi ki?

phrases.english: The shoes are too small for me.
You can do it, one small step.
Keep going, even when it’s tough.
phrases.transliteration: chali jao, jete jiba kashta heau.

phrases.english: Today matters, start now with courage.
phrases.transliteration: aaji gurutwapurna, ebe thu arambha kara.

phrases.english: Believe in yourself, you’ve got strength.
phrases.odia: ନିଜ ଉପରେ ଭରସା କର, ତୁମର ଶକ୍ତି ଅଛି।
phrases.transliteration: nija upara bharasa kara, tumara shakti achhi.

phrases.english: Breathe, then try again, you will learn.
phrases.odia: ଶ୍ୱାସ ନିଅ, ତାପରେ ପୁଣି ଚେଷ୍ଟା କର।
phrases.transliteration: shwasa niau, ta pare puni chesta kara.

phrases.english: My mom makes tasty food, always.
phrases.odia: ମୋ ମା ଭଲ ଖାଦ୍ୟ ତିଆରି କରେ, ସବୁବେଳେ।
phrases.transliteration: mo maa bhala khaadya tiari kare, sabubele.

phrases.english: Dad is fixing something in the garage.
I miss my sister a lot today.
phrases.odia: ଆଜି ମୁଁ ବହୁତ ମୋ ସୁନିଆଙ୍କୁ ମିସ୍ କରୁଛି।
phrases.transliteration: aaji mu̐ bahuta mo suniaṅku mis karuchhi.

phrases.english: Where is your brother right now?
Can you call my grandmother, please?
Please help me, I’m trying my best.
phrases.odia: ଦୟାକରି ମୋତେ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କର, ମୁଁ ଚେଷ୍ଟା କରୁଛି।
phrases.transliteration: Dayakari mote sahajya kara, mu chesta karuchhi.

phrases.english: Thank you, you really made my day.
phrases.odia: ଧନ୍ୟବାଦ, ତୁମେ ସତ୍ୟିକି ମୋ ଦିନଟା ଭଲ କଲା।
phrases.transliteration: Danyabad, tume satyiki mo dinata bhal kala.

phrases.english: Here, take this, it’s no problem.
It’s okay, mistakes happen, be kind.
phrases.odia: କେମିତି ହେବନି, ଭୁଲ ହୁଏ, ଭଲମନ ରଖ।
phrases.transliteration: Kemiti heibani, bhul hue, bhalaman rakha.

phrases.english: You matter, please don’t give up.
phrases.odia: ତୁମେ ମହତ୍ୱପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ, ଦୟାକରି ହାର ମାନିବ ନାହିଁ।
phrases.transliteration: Tume mahatwapurna, dayakari haar maniba nahin.

phrases.english: I still believe, tomorrow will be better.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ତଥାପି ବିଶ୍ୱାସ କରେ, ଆସନ୍ତାକାଲି ଭଲ ହେବ।
phrases.transliteration: Mu thapari biswasa kare, asantakali bhala heba.

phrases.english: Keep going, your hope is growing.
Small steps matter, I will try again.
phrases.odia: ଛୋଟ ପଦକ୍ଷେପ ମାନେ, ମୁଁ ପୁଣି ଚେଷ୍ଟା କରିବି।
phrases.transliteration: Chhota padakshyepa mane, mu pun i chesta karibi.

phrases.english: Even now, good things can happen.
phrases.transliteration: Ebe bi bhala kichhi ghati pare.

phrases.english: We will manage, don’t lose heart.
I forgive you, please understand me.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ତୁମକୁ କ୍ଷମା କରୁଛି, ଦୟାକରି ବୁଝ।
phrases.transliteration: Muṁ tumaku kshyama karuchhi, dayakari bujha.

phrases.english: Let’s move on, I’ve forgiven you.
phrases.odia: ଚଲ, ଆଗକୁ ବଢ଼ିବା, ମୁଁ ତୁମକୁ କ୍ଷମା କରିଛି।
phrases.transliteration: Chal, agaku badhiba, muṁ tumaku kshyama karichhi.

phrases.english: You didn’t mean it, it’s okay.
I release the hurt, truly.
Please don’t apologize again and again.
phrases.odia: ଦୟାକରି ଆଉ ପୁଣି ପୁଣି ଦୁଃଖ ପ୍ରକାଶ କରିନାହିଁ।
phrases.transliteration: Dayakari āu puni puni duḥkha prakāśa karināhīn.

phrases.english: Hi, do you have a table for two?
phrases.odia: ନମସ୍କାର, ଦୁଇଜଣଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ଟେବୁଲ୍ ଅଛି କି?
phrases.transliteration: Namaskara, dui jananka pain table achhi ki?

phrases.english: We’re ready to order, please.
What do you recommend today?
Is your menu available in English?
Can I see the menu, please?
phrases.transliteration: Mu dashy kari menu dekhī paribi ki?

phrases.english: I feel happy right now,
I feel nervous,
I feel calm today,
I feel sad about this,
I feel excited,
Listen first, then speak with care.
phrases.transliteration: Prathame suna, ta pare saavadhane kah.

phrases.english: A calm mind finds better solutions.
Respect others, it always returns.
Small steps, every day, make progress.
Think before you answer someone.
Go straight ahead, then turn left.
phrases.odia: ସିଧା ଆଗକୁ ଯାଆନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ବାମକୁ ଘୁରନ୍ତୁ।
phrases.transliteration: siḍhā āgaku yāāntu, tāpare bāmakū ghurantu

phrases.english: Turn right at the next street.
Walk two minutes, then stop here.
phrases.odia: ଦୁଇ ମିନିଟ୍ ଚାଲନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଏଠାରେ ଅଟକନ୍ତୁ।
phrases.transliteration: dui miṇiṭ cālantū, tāpare eṭhāre aṭakantu

phrases.english: Please follow me to the station.
Is the bus stop this way, please?
Hello, where is the nearest bus stop?
phrases.odia: ନମସ୍କାର, ସବୁଠାରୁ ନିକଟତମ ବସ୍ ଷ୍ଟପ୍ କେଉଁଠି?
phrases.transliteration: Namaskar, sabutharu nikatotama bas stop keunthi?

phrases.english: How much is a ticket to Puri?
Is this train going to Cuttack?
Where can I buy a SIM card?
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ କେଉଁଠି ଏକ SIM କାର୍ଡ କିଣିପାରିବି?
phrases.transliteration: Mu kemiti kahi? Mu keunthi eka SIM card kiniparibi?

phrases.english: I need a taxi, please, right now.
I can do this, I believe in myself.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ଏହା କରିପାରିବି, ମୋ ଉପରେ ଆସ୍ଥା ଅଛି।
phrases.transliteration: Mu eha kariparibi, mo upare astha achhi.

phrases.english: I’ve got this, don’t worry about me.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ଏହା କରିନେବି, ମୋ ବିଷୟରେ ଚିନ୍ତା କରନି।
phrases.transliteration: Mu eha karinebi, mo bishayare chinta karani.

phrases.english: My hard work will pay off, soon.
phrases.odia: ମୋର କଷ୍ଟ ଶ୍ରମ ଫଳ ଦେବ, ଶୀଘ୍ର।
phrases.transliteration: Mora kashta shram phala deb, shighra.

phrases.english: I’m ready, I can start right now.
Stay calm, I’ll handle it.
phrases.transliteration: Shanta ruh, mu eha dekhi nebi.

phrases.english: I’m learning step by step, with patience.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ଧୀରେ ଧୀରେ ଶିଖୁଛି, ଧୈର୍ଯ୍ୟ ସହିତ।
phrases.transliteration: Muṁ dhīre dhīre śikhuchhi, dhairjya sahitā.

phrases.english: Let me say it clearly, please.
Thanks for correcting me, gently.
I can do it, even today.
My confidence grows, every time I speak.
Please wait, I’m almost ready.
phrases.odia: ଦୟାକରି ଅପେକ୍ଷା କରନ୍ତୁ, ମୁଁ ଶୀଘ୍ର ତିଆରି ହେଉଛି।
phrases.transliteration: Dayakari apekhya karantu, mu̐ shighra t̤airi heuchhi

phrases.english: Just breathe, everything will be okay.
phrases.odia: କେବଳ ଶ୍ୱାସ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ, ସବୁ ଠିକ୍ ହେବ।
phrases.transliteration: Kebala shwas nioùntū, sabu thik hebā

phrases.english: Wait a moment, I’m coming now.
phrases.odia: ଦୟାକରି ଗୋଟେ ମହୁର୍ତ୍ତ ଅପେକ୍ଷା କରନ୍ତୁ, ମୁଁ ଏବେ ଆସୁଛି।
phrases.transliteration: Dayakari gotē muhūrtta apekhya karantu, mu̐ ebe asuchi

phrases.english: Be patient, it takes time.
I know it’s slow, but stay calm.
phrases.odia: ଜାଣିଛି ଧୀରେ ହେଉଛି, ତଥାପି ଶାନ୍ତ ରୁହନ୍ତୁ।
phrases.transliteration: Jānichhi dhīre heuchhi, tathāpi shānta ruhantu

phrases.english: You're my best friend, always, my sister.
phrases.odia: ତୁମେ ମୋର ସର୍ବଶ୍ରେଷ୍ଠ ବନ୍ଧୁ, ସବୁବେଳେ, ମୋ ଭଉଣୀ।
phrases.transliteration: tume mora sarbashreshtha bandhu, sabubele, mo bhauṇī

phrases.english: Thanks for listening, I really needed that.
phrases.odia: ଶୁଣିଥିବାପାଇଁ ଧନ୍ୟବାଦ, ମୋତେ ସତରେ ଦରକାର ଥିଲା।
phrases.transliteration: suṇithibāpaĭ dhanyabāda, mote satare darkār thilā

phrases.english: We laugh together, and it feels easy.
phrases.odia: ଆମେ ଏକାଠି ହସୁଥାଉ, ଆଉ ଲାଗେ ସହଜ।
phrases.transliteration: amē ekāṭi hasuthāu, āu lāge sahaj

phrases.english: Call me anytime, I’ll be there.
Stay close, friendship like this matters.
You’ve got this, keep going.
Believe in yourself, you’re improving.
phrases.odia: ନିଜ ଉପରେ ଭରସା କର, ତୁମେ ସୁଧୁରୁଛ।
phrases.transliteration: nija upare bharasa kara, tume sudhuruchha

phrases.english: Small steps bring big success.
phrases.odia: ଛୋଟ ଛୋଟ ପଦକ୍ଷେପ, ବଡ଼ ସଫଳତା ଆଣେ।
phrases.transliteration: chhota chhota padakhep, bada safalatā āṇe

phrases.english: Stay focused, success is near.
Today’s effort will pay off.
It is red, very bright.
That wall is blue.
My shirt is green today.
The sky looks gray, wow!
This flower is yellow.
Good morning, today will be wonderful.
phrases.odia: ଶୁଭ ସକାଳ, ଆଜି ନିଶ୍ଚୟ ଭଲ ହେବ।
phrases.transliteration: Shubha sakāḷa, āji niścaya bhala heba.

phrases.english: I choose calm, even in busy days.
Small steps, big dreams, everyday progress.
phrases.odia: ଛୋଟ ପଦକ୍ଷେପ, ବଡ଼ ସ୍ୱପ୍ନ, ପ୍ରତିଦିନ ଅଗ୍ରଗତି।
phrases.transliteration: Choṭa padakṣepa, baḍa svapna, pratidin agragati.

phrases.english: Today is a fresh start for me.
I’m grateful for simple moments.
I’m feeling thirsty right now, please water.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ବର୍ତ୍ତମାନ ତିରିଆ ଲାଗୁଛି, ଦୟାକରି ପାଣି ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।
phrases.transliteration: muṁ bartamāna tiriā lāguchhi, dayākarī pāṇi diantu.

phrases.english: Try slow breathing, it helps your body.
phrases.odia: ଧୀରେ ଧୀରେ ଶ୍ୱାସ ନିଅ, ଏହା ତୁମ ଶରୀରକୁ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରେ।
phrases.transliteration: dhīre dhīre śvās nîa, eha tum śarīraku sāhājya kare.

phrases.english: My throat hurts, I need warm tea.
phrases.odia: ମୋ ଗଳା ଦରୁଛି, ମୋତେ ଗରମ ଚାହା ପଡ଼ିବ।
phrases.transliteration: mo galā daruchhi, mote garama chāhā paḍib.

phrases.english: Don’t forget your medicine, take it after meal.
phrases.odia: ତୁମର ଔଷଧ ଭୁଲିବ ନାହିଁ, ଖାଦ୍ୟ ପରେ ଖାଅ।
phrases.transliteration: tumara auṣadha bhuliba nāhī, khādya pare khāa.

phrases.english: I slept well last night, I’m relieved.
phrases.odia: ଗତରାତି ଭଲ ଭାବରେ ଶୋଇଥିଲି, ମୁଁ ଆରାମ ପାଇଲି।
phrases.transliteration: gatarāti bhala bhābare soithili, muṁ ārāma pāilī.

phrases.english: This melody is really beautiful.
Which song is this, please?
Can you sing the chorus?
I know this tune from before.
Let’s listen quietly for a minute.
